context.axis: does the mixed p/n chain close in the same way the homogeneous one did?
context.answer: Yes. One factor per bond, with b_pp equal to the Markov parameter z to 4.6e-16. Delta_tr(Z,N) = t_p^Z t_n^N (1 - b_pp^(Z-1) b_pn b_nn^(N-1)) — five numbers for every atom, no matrices, so the n >= 15 dimension wall does not bear on the question it was blocking.
context.derived_vs_measured: DERIVED: the form (chain structure plus Ocneanu multiplicativity over disjoint strand ranges); t_p and t_n as H_3 traces; b_pp = z as an identification, not an imposition. NOT DERIVED: b_pn and b_nn are extracted from 2H and 3H and are two measured constants until the exact-Laurent treatment that produced r(q) is applied to them.
